title: EnvelopeInputLayout
description: Added in runner protocol 1.1 (blocwerk staging-o7, PRs #239/#240; not on main yet): GET .../bundle of a 'splat-prepare' / 'splat-finish' job: parts.json first, then one stored entry per file part (RunnerComputeEnvelope). The instance is the list of the zip's entry names, in order.
